messages:
Alex P: Heads-up — customer ACME is blocked on a large training job, their SLA requires capacity by EOD PST. Reservation 98765 is stuck in waitlist (pending fulfillment). Can we escalate or move them to Dedicated temporarily? :warning:
Maria K: Checking pools now. us-west2 regular pools are saturated, but we have a small Dedicated pool with spare capacity if we can override the queue. pinging infra oncall. :eyes:
Jamal: Confirmed — free GPUs in dedicated-g4-pool-2 (3 nodes) but the reservation is tied to standard waitlist rules. We can manually swap to Dedicated but need billing/commit approval (short-term 1mo commit ok).
InfraBot: Reservation 98765 status: WAITLIST -> HOLD (billing_check). ETA fulfillment: unknown. Linked request: https://console.redwood.example/reservations/98765
Alex P: Can someone scope the cost delta for a 1-month dedicated swap vs waiting? Customer will pay overage but legal needs a firm timeline.
Priya F: Finance: There's an org-level spend hold on team "vision-platform" (soft cap exceeded). I can approve a one-time exception if PM or Eng manager approves and authors a cost-backfill note. Need estimate before I sign off.
Maria K: Quick estimate: swapping to Dedicated 3x A100-equivalent for 30 days ~= $38k extra (ballpark). If we do a 30% route to Dedicated (canary) then ~ $11k. I'll post a more detailed calc in 15m.
Jamal: Command to do manual swap (dry-run first):
```
rictl reservation swap --id 98765 --to-dedicated --pool dedicated-g4-pool-2 --commitment 1mo --dry-run
```
Alex P: @Priya F can you tentatively unlock org hold for a 1-time exception pending Maria's detailed calc? Customer legal needs timeline.
Priya F: Tentative yes for a one-time exception up to $15k. If the full swap exceeds that, will need exec approval. Please proceed with canary routing and dry-run first.
Maria K: Will run dry-run and return numbers. Plan B: cross-region burst to us-east1 for lower cost if customer accepts slight latency increase.
Jamal: I'll prepare a routing change snippet for canary:
```
routes:
  - name: acme-canary
    match: customer_id:acme
    distribution:
      - destination: dedicated-g4-pool-2
        weight: 30
      - destination: standard-pool-us-west2
        weight: 70
    fallback: standard-pool-us-east1
```
DeployBot: Routing change proposal queued as change-4332. Runbook: notify customer, monitor token latency, rollback within 10m on error. :white_check_mark:
Alex P: OK let's do canary route + dry-run swap. Maria/Jamal — post the exact cost calc here when ready and start the swap once Priya confirms the final figure.
Maria K: Cost calc: dry-run shows dedicated full-swap = $41,200/month. Canary (30%) ~= $12,360/month. Cross-region burst (us-east1) ~= $9,100/month but +120ms median latency. I'll attach spreadsheet in #help but summary here.
Priya F: Approving the canary up to $13k. Please create a cost-backfill ticket and tag finance.
Jamal: Kicking off dry-run now. Will post dry-run output and then request final swap. ETA ~20m.
InfraBot: Dry-run complete for reservation 98765. Predicted routing effect: 30% to dedicated-g4-pool-2. Predicted cost delta: +$12,410/month. No quota violations.
Alex P: :thumbsup: Thanks team. Keep monitoring and call me if we hit any allocation errors.
Maria K: Will do. Follow-up: if dedicated pool depletion looks likely we'll pre-stage an additional node in us-west2 (manual). That needs 2h lead time for boot + setup.
Priya F: Finance note created: FIN-1289 (cost-backfill). Tagging PM for approval.
Alex P: Closing loop — proceed with canary swap and notify ACME. Report back when live.
